result.description: A compact desktop connectivity hub designed for creators who need a clean multi-device desk setup. The Nebula Dock combines four USB-C data ports, one HDMI output, SD card reading, and a single upstream Thunderbridge link for laptops and tablets. It emphasizes cable consolidation, peripheral switching, and travel-friendly desk expansion rather than storage or graphics workloads.
result.title: LumaCraft Nebula Dock 4-Port Thunderbridge Hub
result.title_description: Compact USB-C desktop hub with HDMI, card reader, and four downstream ports
